newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end steady in line with Spain.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end steady in line with Spain.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended little changed after a dull session, but dealers said they expected a boost in short bond prices tomorrow amid optimism over April inflation numbers due to be released later this month.
Dealers said that a holiday in Germany tomorrow would reduce turnover in longer bonds, which have held spreads of around 90 basis points against Bunds recently.

"Ten-year bonds hardly budged and closed well-supported," a fixed income analyst said. He added that spreads of 10-year bonds were likely to remain in a range of between five and 10 basis points against Bonos.
The escudo closed steady at 100.51/54 per mark after trading in a tight range throughout the session, dealers said.
